# Aakash Remesh

> Bookkeeping and accounting systems consultant with 9+ years of experience. Aakash sets up, cleans up and migrates accounting systems (QuickBooks Online, Intuit Enterprise Suite, Sage Intacct, Oracle NetSuite, Zoho Books and Xero) for eCommerce, SaaS, manufacturing and multi-entity businesses in the United States, India, New Zealand and Europe. Based in Kerala, India; works remotely.

## Services

- Accounting system setup: Chart of Accounts, opening balances, bank feeds and integrations, configured from scratch.
- Platform migrations: QuickBooks Desktop, Xero or spreadsheets to cloud accounting, with opening balances validated and history reconciled.
- eCommerce reconciliation: Shopify Payments, Amazon, PayPal and Stripe payouts through A2X and MyWorks, including fees, refunds, reserves and COGS.
- Multi-entity and intercompany accounting: due-to/due-from, eliminations and consolidated reporting.
- Inventory accounting: BOMs, assemblies, COGS tracking and landed costs.
- Month-end close, cleanup and reporting: catch-up projects, SaaS deferred revenue, Excel MIS models and dashboards.
- Every engagement ends with written SOPs so the client's team can run the process.

## Credentials

- QuickBooks Online Certification, Level 2 (Intuit, 2026; QuickBooks Online certified since 2024)
- Intuit Enterprise Suite Certification (Intuit, 2026); Intuit Bookkeeping Certification
- Xero Certified Professional, Level 2 and Xero Certified Associate, Level 1 (Xero, 2025, valid to 2027)
- Certified Zoho Books Associate (Zoho, 2026; first certified 2024)
- Career Essentials in Data Analysis (Microsoft & LinkedIn, 2023)
- MBA, Finance (International Institute of Business Studies, 2021); B.Com, Taxation (University of Kerala, 2017)

## Experience

- Client Ops Specialist, Renocrew Solutions (2025–present)
- Client Ops Specialist, Supagigs (2025)
